result.reason: The revised cap is mutual and matches the preferred monetary formulation while narrowly correcting the restrictive Fees definition. However, the operative language supplied does not establish the required Excluded Claims; the margin comment cannot substitute for an operative definition. It also does not provide the preferred mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, the IP-infringement carve-out, or clarification that Customer payment obligations are not damages. Without operative confirmation of at least the fallback carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, and wilful misconduct, compliance with even the fallback is not demonstrated.
